credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Gloriosa superba, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gloriosa_superba . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Gloriosa superba. LUNGING: the climbing vine arches from its forked tuber toward the foe and thrusts out its flower: six long tepals swept back and up like flames, red with wavy yellow edges, and six long curved stamens flung toward the foe; a second, smaller flower climbs behind and tendril-tipped leaves grip the air. Gesture: the petals flicker (the tepals' tips lick up and back in a wave, hold and settle); vine, leaves and tuber stay fixed. A flame-red dark slot (the tepals, the tuber's rust, the leaf shade) under a yellow-green mid (the tepals' wavy edges, the stamens, the leaves and shoot). Sport: the all-yellow form, Gloriosa superba 'Lutea'.
